name: Zipline Tour
paras: Zipline Canopy Tour – Guanacaste, Costa Rica
This thrilling canopy tour features 10 cables suspended up to 120 meters high and 580 meters long, with short hikes of 10–30 meters between platforms.
Cost: $75 per person (tax included)
Transportation included (add $10 per person from JW Marriott, Pinilla, or Westin – minimum 4 people).
Duration: Pickup at 8am | Approx. 3.5 hours including drive time (30 minutes from Tamarindo)
Weight Limit: 280–300 lbs, waist size under 47.5 inches
What to Bring: Comfortable shoes and clothes, bug repellent, sunscreen

name: ATV Tour
paras: ATV Tours – Tamarindo & Flamingo, Costa Rica

Our ATV tours are one of the most popular adventures in Tamarindo and Flamingo. The 4-hour private ATV tour is a favorite at $170 per person, though we also offer 2–4 hour options. On the 4-hour tour, you’ll ride through beaches, mountains, towns, and back roads—all at your own pace. Stop anytime to swim, eat, take photos, or relax. Because the tours are private, you won’t be stuck in a group going too slow or too fast—you choose the pace.
Age Requirement: Must be at least 16 years old to drive.
What to Bring: Comfortable shoes and clothes that can get dirty, bathing suit, bug repellent, sunscreen, camera.

rates.label: Pick your ride
rates.note: Minimum two machines; rates vary for solo travellers. Transportation included, add $10 per person from JW Marriott or Pinilla, or $20 per side-by-side. Extra person on a side-by-side: $20 on the 2 hour, $30 on the 3 hour, $40 on the 4 hour.

name: Sunset Catamaran
paras: Sunset Catamaran Cruise – Tamarindo & Flamingo, Costa Rica

Sail the Pacific on a luxury catamaran while enjoying snorkeling, stand-up paddleboarding, swimming, and a late lunch (served around 3pm). Unlimited drinks—both alcoholic and non-alcoholic—are included. Relax as you watch the stunning Costa Rica sunset over the ocean.
Rates (tax included):
Tamarindo: Adults $125 | Kids 5–11 $74 | Under 5 free (no transportation)
Flamingo: Adults $125 | Kids 5–12 $74 | Under 5 free (transportation included)
Add $10 pp for JW Marriott or Pinilla pickups.
Duration: Meet at 1pm | Return around 5:45pm
Private charters available upon request.

name: All-Day Mega Combo Tour – Guanacaste
paras: All-Day Mega Combo Tour – Guanacaste
For thrill-seekers, this all-day tour includes ziplining, river tubing, horseback riding, rock climbing, hot springs, and volcanic mud baths—plus a traditional Costa Rican lunch.
Cost: $195 per person (minimum 4 people) | Private $225 per person (minimum 2 people)
Duration: Pickup at 7:30am | Return 6:30–7pm (2 hrs from Tamarindo)
Included: Transportation, guide, lunch, all activities
What to Bring: Shoes/clothes that can get wet, bathing suit, towel, sunscreen, bug repellent, camera, change of clothes

name: Volcano Hike / Mud Baths
paras: Volcano Hike, Hot Springs & Mud Bath – Rincon de la Vieja

Begin with a 3-hour guided hike in the Pailas Sector of Rincon de la Vieja Volcano, where you’ll see wildlife such as toucans, capuchin monkeys, howler monkeys, coatis, and more. Along the way, explore bubbling mud pots, fumaroles, and a mini crater. Cool off with a swim at Oropendola Waterfall, then enjoy a typical Costa Rican lunch. End the day soaking in the Rio Negro hot springs and rejuvenating volcanic mud baths.
Cost: $190 per person (tax included, based on 4 people – rates may vary for smaller groups or private tours)
Duration: Pickup at 6:30am | Return approx. 6–7pm (2 hours from Tamarindo)
Included: Transportation, guide, lunch, entrance fees
What to Bring: Walking shoes, comfortable clothes, bathing suit, towel, sunscreen, bug repellent, camera, change of clothes

name: White Water Rafting
paras: Ride the Rapids with GoFish Costa Rica’s White Water Rafting Adventure

Get ready for a high-energy, unforgettable experience with our White Water Rafting tour in the heart of Guanacaste. Perfect for thrill-seekers and nature lovers alike, this tour takes you deep into Costa Rica’s lush interior, where inland rivers challenge and excite with a mix of beginner to intermediate rapids ranging from Class III to Class V.

Led by professional bilingual guides, you’ll navigate powerful currents, paddle through fast-moving channels, and conquer roaring rapids that keep your adrenaline pumping from start to finish. Along the way, your guide will point out the incredible wildlife that thrives in the surrounding rainforest—keep an eye out for monkeys, tropical birds, and other hidden jungle residents.

Each rapid presents a new challenge, requiring teamwork, focus, and a sense of adventure. Whether you're a first-time rafter or a seasoned paddler, the experience is designed to be safe, exhilarating, and unforgettable.

Between the rapids, enjoy the moments of calm as you float through serene sections of river, soaking in the beauty of the jungle around you. This mix of excitement and natural immersion makes white water rafting in Costa Rica one of the most rewarding outdoor adventures available.
At GoFish Costa Rica, we take safety seriously and pride ourselves on offering top-notch gear, experienced guides, and a fun, supportive environment for all skill levels.
Book your White Water Rafting adventure today and experience the wild energy of Costa Rica’s rivers firsthand!

name: Waterfall Hike
paras: Waterfall Hike – La Leona Waterfalls, Guanacaste

Take a moderate 1–2 hour hike (each way) through the jungle along the Rio Blanco River, crossing streams, caverns, and lush rainforest before arriving at the stunning La Leona Waterfalls. Swim, relax, and take in the scenery before hiking back. End your day with a traditional Costa Rican lunch at a local restaurant.
Cost: $170 per person (tax included, based on minimum 4 people – private tours available)
Duration: Pickup at 8am | Return approx. 3:30pm (1.5 hours from Tamarindo)
Included: Transportation, guide, entrance fees, lunch
What to Bring: Walking shoes that can get wet, bathing suit, towel, sunscreen, bug repellent, camera, change of clothes

name: Birdwatching Tour
paras: Welcome to GoFish's immersive birdwatching expeditions in the enchanting landscapes of Costa Rica's Guanacaste province. Prepare to be captivated by the kaleidoscope of avian life that calls this biodiverse region home.

Led by our knowledgeable guides, our birdwatching tours offer enthusiasts of all levels the opportunity to spot a wide array of feathered wonders amidst the lush forests, wetlands, and coastal habitats of Guanacaste. Whether you're a seasoned birder or a novice enthusiast, our expert guides will enhance your experience with fascinating insights into the behaviors and habitats of the region's avian inhabitants.

As you venture into the heart of Guanacaste's natural wonders, keep your binoculars at the ready to catch sight of brilliantly colored toucans, majestic hawks soaring overhead, and elusive species hidden amongst the foliage. With each sighting, you'll deepen your appreciation for the rich biodiversity of Costa Rica's ecosystems.

At GoFish, we're committed to responsible ecotourism, prioritizing the conservation of habitat and species while offering unforgettable birdwatching experiences. Join us as we embark on a journey through the avian paradise of Guanacaste, where every sighting is a moment of wonder and discovery.

name: Tamarindo Estuary Boat Tour
paras: Tamarindo Estuary Boat Tour

Conveniently located in Tamarindo, this 2-hour estuary boat ride explores the mangroves where you’ll see iguanas, crocodiles, caimans, exotic birds, and howler monkeys. Includes a short jungle walk for wildlife spotting.
Cost: $60 per person (tax included)
Duration: 2 hours (pickup times vary with the tides)
Included: Transportation in Tamarindo, guide, boat ride
What to Bring: Comfortable shoes and clothes, bug repellent, sunscreen, camera, binoculars

name: Riverboat & Pottery Farm Tour
paras: Riverboat & Pottery Farm Tour – Tempisque River & Guaitil, Guanacaste

A two-hour boat ride on the Tempisque River along the edge of Palo Verde National Park, one of the best wildlife corridors in the country. Keep your eyes on the banks and the branches: monkeys, iguanas, scarlet macaws, anteaters, crocodiles and caimans all turn up here, and they are often just sitting there in plain sight. The boat is covered and unhurried, so every age gets a good look.

Afterwards you sit down to a traditional Costa Rican lunch, then carry on to the pottery village of Guaitil, where families still shape, paint and fire Chorotega pottery by hand the way it has been made here for centuries. You see the whole process, and you can take a piece home.
Cost: Adults $110 | Kids under 10 $90 (tax included, based on minimum 4 people – rates may vary for smaller groups or private tours)
Duration: Pickup at 7am | Return approx. 2–3pm (about 1 hr 15 min from Tamarindo)
Included: Transportation, park fee, 2-hour boat ride, traditional Costa Rican lunch, Guaitil pottery village, bilingual guide
What to Bring: Comfortable shoes and clothes, bug repellent, sunscreen, camera, binoculars

name: Horseback Riding
paras: At GoFish Costa Rica, we invite you to experience the thrill and beauty of horseback riding in Guanacaste. Picture yourself riding a majestic horse through lush rainforests, along pristine beaches, and up rugged mountain trails, with the natural splendor of Costa Rica all around you. Guanacaste is renowned for its diverse landscapes and rich biodiversity, making it the perfect destination for an unforgettable horseback riding adventure.

Our tours cater to all skill levels, from beginners to experienced riders, ensuring that everyone can enjoy the journey. Friendly and knowledgeable guides will accompany you, sharing fascinating insights into the local culture, history, and ecology, enriching your experience. Whether you prefer a leisurely ride through the forest, an exhilarating gallop along the coast, or a challenging mountain trail, we have the perfect adventure for you.

At GoFish Costa Rica, your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. Our well-trained horses and comprehensive briefings ensure a comfortable and enjoyable ride. We are also committed to sustainable tourism practices, aiming to minimize environmental impact and support local communities. Join us for a horseback riding experience in Guanacaste that promises not just stunning views and encounters with wildlife, but also memories that will last a lifetime. Contact us today to book your adventure and explore the breathtaking landscapes of Costa Rica.
Rates start at $75 per person.

name: Monteverde Cloud Forest Tour
paras: Monteverde Cloud Forest Tour

Travel to the Monteverde Cloud Forest, one of Costa Rica’s most famous destinations. Choose 2 activities: Butterfly Gardens, Insect Museum, Reptile Exhibit, Ziplining (13 cables & Tarzan swing), or Hanging Bridges (8 bridges up to 560 ft long).
Cost: $225 per person (based on 4 people – private tours available)
Duration: Pickup at 6:30am | Return 7pm (3 hrs each way from Tamarindo)
Included: Transportation, guide, entrance fees, lunch
What to Bring: Clothes for varying weather, rain gear, closed shoes, sunscreen, bug repellent, camera

name: Rio Celeste Hike – Tenorio Volcano National Park
paras: Rio Celeste Hike – Tenorio Volcano National Park

Take a 2-hour hike along rainforest trails to the breathtaking Rio Celeste Waterfall, where volcanic minerals create a turquoise-blue river. Wildlife sightings may include sloths, toucans, and monkeys. Afterward, enjoy a traditional Costa Rican lunch.
Cost: $195 per person (based on 4 people – private tours available)
Duration: Pickup at 7am | Return 6–7pm (3 hrs from Tamarindo)
Included: Transportation, guide, lunch, entrance fees
What to Bring: Walking shoes, comfortable clothes, bathing suit, towel, sunscreen, bug repellent, camera, change of clothes

name: Snorkeling
paras: Welcome to GoFish's mesmerizing snorkeling adventures in Costa Rica's enchanting Guanacaste province. Dive into the crystal-clear waters and discover a world of wonder beneath the surface, where vibrant marine life awaits.

Our experienced guides ensure your safety and provide expert guidance as you explore the rich biodiversity of Guanacaste's underwater realm. From colorful fish to graceful sea turtles, every snorkel offers a glimpse into the beauty of the marine ecosystem.

At GoFish, we are committed to eco-conscious practices, encouraging responsible interaction with the delicate marine environment. Join us for an unforgettable aquatic adventure, where the wonders of Guanacaste's underwater world come to life in stunning clarity.

name: Surf Lessons
paras: Surf Lessons – Tamarindo, Costa Rica

Learn to surf in Tamarindo, one of Costa Rica’s best surf towns. 2-hour surf lessons are tailored to beginners, families, and kids. Extra instructors available for children. Lesson times depend on the tides.
Rates vary with group size and how many lessons you want. Tell us who is surfing and we will quote you.

name: Turtle Tour
paras: Embark on a once-in-a-lifetime adventure with our Turtle Tour at GoFish Costa Rica. Along the pristine shores of Guanacaste, you'll have the incredible opportunity to witness one of nature's most awe-inspiring events—the nesting of majestic sea turtles.

Join our knowledgeable guides as they lead you on a journey to secluded beaches where these magnificent creatures return year after year to lay their eggs. As the sun sets and the moon rises, you'll witness the ancient ritual of mother turtles making their way ashore to dig nests and deposit their precious eggs.

Under the cover of darkness, you'll have the privilege of observing these gentle giants in their natural habitat, illuminated only by the soft glow of the moon and stars. Our experienced guides will share fascinating insights into the life cycle and behavior of sea turtles, enriching your experience with their expert knowledge.

As you marvel at the sight of mother turtles carefully burying their eggs in the sand, you'll gain a newfound appreciation for the importance of conservation efforts to protect these endangered species. Learn about the conservation initiatives in place to safeguard sea turtle populations and how you can contribute to their preservation.

At GoFish Costa Rica, we are committed to responsible tourism practices, ensuring that our Turtle Tours have minimal impact on nesting turtles and their habitats. Join us for a Turtle Tour and witness the wonder of nature as you become part of a timeless tradition that spans generations. Contact us today to book your unforgettable turtle nesting experience in Costa Rica.
Rates: $65 per person.

name: Spa Package – Tamarindo, Costa Rica
paras: Spa Package – Tamarindo, Costa Rica

Relax with a half-day spa experience near Tamarindo. Choose any 3 treatments (massage, facial, wrap, scrub, manicure, pedicure, soaking tub). Enjoy a saltwater pool, gourmet lunch with wine, and full transportation.
Cost: $315 per person (three treatments, lunch with wine and transportation included)
Duration: Morning 9am–2pm | Afternoon 12:30pm–5pm (15 min drive from Tamarindo)
Included: Three spa treatments, saltwater pool, lunch with 2 glasses of wine, transportation
What to Bring: Swimsuit (for pool), clean skin, camera, cash for tips
